cards.answer: Zed is an AD assassin whose abilities deal mainly physical damage. His shadows copy shurikens and slashes, and he can swap places with them. Death Mark rewards follow-up damage with a delayed burst.
cards.counterplay: Avoid overlapping attacks from Zed and his shadows; limit his follow-up damage while marked.

cards.answer: Contempt for the Weak makes Zed's basic attacks against low-health targets deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health. It cannot trigger again on the same champion for a while.
cards.counterplay: Avoid lingering within basic attack range when low on health.

cards.answer: Razor Shuriken sends shurikens from Zed and his shadows through enemies, dealing physical damage. A shuriken deals reduced damage after passing through an enemy.
cards.counterplay: Dodge away from converging shuriken paths; use intervening enemies to reduce incoming damage.

facts.claim: A shuriken deals reduced damage after passing through an enemy.

cards.priority_reason: Shadow shurikens create his main ranged damage threat.

cards.answer: Living Shadow places a shadow that copies Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash; Zed can recast within range to swap places with it. Hitting the same target with the same ability from Zed and a shadow, or from multiple shadows, restores energy.
cards.counterplay: Respect the shadow as an attack origin and a possible swap destination; avoid overlapping hits.

citations.quote: Active: Zed sends a Shadow to the target location that will remain for a few seconds, being able to mimic his Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash. Living Shadow can be recast while within range of the Shadow. Recast: Zed and the Shadow blink to swap places.

facts.claim: Living Shadow places a shadow that copies Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash; Zed can recast within range to swap places with it.

citations.quote: Passive: Zed restores energy whenever he and his Shadows or multiple Shadows hit an ability on the same target.

facts.claim: Hitting the same target with the same ability from Zed and a shadow, or from multiple shadows, restores energy.

cards.priority_reason: Defines his attack angles, repositioning and energy recovery.

cards.answer: Shadow Slash deals physical damage around Zed and his shadows; shadow slashes also slow. Overlapping slashes strengthen the slow without adding damage. Zed's own slash reduces Living Shadow's remaining cooldown when it hits enemy champions.
cards.counterplay: Keep away from shadow slash range and avoid clustering around Zed.

facts.claim: Shadow Slash deals physical damage around Zed and his shadows; shadow slashes also slow.

facts.claim: Overlapping slashes strengthen the slow without adding damage.

citations.quote: Living Shadow's current cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds for each enemy champion hit by Zed's slash.

facts.claim: Zed's own slash reduces Living Shadow's remaining cooldown when it hits enemy champions.

cards.priority_reason: The slow helps set up shurikens, while close combat can accelerate his next shadow.

cards.answer: Death Mark makes Zed untargetable as he dashes to an enemy champion and marks them. The mark later detonates for physical damage, storing a portion of the physical and magic damage Zed and his shadows deal while it lasts. He leaves a shadow at his casting position that copies shurikens and slashes, and can recast to swap with it.
cards.counterplay: Save defensive tools for his follow-up attacks and the detonation; account for his return shadow when chasing.
